title.purpose: Formal quality decision; mobile size is 23px.

reading.purpose: Decision reasons and task descriptions; readable measure up to 72ch.

shadows.name: navigation-glass
shadows.purpose: Header and run-section index only; inner light and soft downward depth.

shadows.name: default-rest
shadows.purpose: Default buttons and opaque work surfaces do not receive an added ambient shadow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Shared authored control and navigation easing.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Color, fill, border, shadow and small press response; never backdrop blur.

motion.name: primary-press
motion.purpose: Enabled primary press; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: run-tab-pane
motion.purpose: Run Tabs animated prop disables pane animation.

motion.name: provider-motion
motion.purpose: Mount the Ant motion wrapper from the first render; follow matchMedia changes without remounting pages or losing drafts.

materials.name: navigation-glass
materials.purpose: Static backdrop filter on header and run-section navigation only; no nested glass.

materials.name: navigation-fallback
materials.purpose: Base material without filter support; also used under reduced transparency or increased contrast.

materials.name: forced-colors
materials.purpose: Remove backdrop filtering and shadows; preserve current-navigation outlines.

focus.name: authored-focus
focus.purpose: Visible keyboard focus; Ant colorPrimaryBorder shares the same accent.

Create project

narrative.overview:
HyperTest One places a quiet, floating control plane above stable testing records. Pale cool canvas, white reading surfaces, graphite text and one blue action accent keep daily QA work clear. Frosted navigation gains definition from an inner light and a soft downward shadow; aligned records, immutable identifiers and adjacent evidence retain the reference-index structure.

The material direction adapts Apple's [Meet Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/219/) and [Get to know the new design system](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/356/) to the existing web workspace. The reusable principles are separation between navigation and content, related corner geometry, restrained interaction feedback and legibility across user preferences. The implementation uses CSS translucency and backdrop filtering, with opaque alternatives; native optical refraction is not implemented.

Daily operation determines density and typography. A decision stays close to its reason and evidence, supporting metadata stays readable, and Chinese and English receive the same hierarchy. These rules describe the current checkout's shared stylesheet, Ant Design provider and application components. Product and canonical-state semantics remain governed by PRODUCT.md and the four foundational specifications.
keyCharacteristics: Floating light navigation with a single frosted material per navigation surface.
Opaque records, forms, decisions and evidence on a pale cool canvas.
Related rounded geometry, capsule primary actions and quiet control feedback.
Readable Chinese and English, stable drafts and explicit unknown or recorded-result states.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written status and, where present, an icon. An accent color or completed workflow never supplies a quality verdict.

rules.name: The Action Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep the complete testing cycle as the principal run action; group secondary planning, execution, gate and input actions in the existing More actions disclosure.

rules.name: The Navigation Material Rule
rules.body: Apply backdrop filtering only to the shared header and run-section navigation. Keep decisions, evidence, tables, forms and reading surfaces opaque; controls within a glass surface use fills rather than a second glass layer.

dos: Do use the pale cool canvas, floating light navigation, blue actions and opaque reading surfaces for new operating pages.
Do keep decisions, reasons, record identity and evidence reachable in one reading path.
Do preserve bilingual drafts, selected run sections, loaded results and immutable history during updates.
Do give readable help the muted description token and reserve a separate line for textarea counters.
Do pair state color with readable labels, preserve visible keyboard focus and keep short project status labels intact.
Do retain solid navigation fallbacks and the stable reduced-motion provider structure.
Do distinguish unknown, unavailable, zero, task completion and formal quality decisions.
donts: Don't stack glass on glass or apply backdrop filtering to decisions, evidence, tables, forms or reading surfaces.
Don't animate blur or add decorative entrance sequences to routine testing work.
Don't infer release readiness from task success, coverage counts or an Agent report.
Don't let dense tables or long identifiers create whole-page horizontal overflow.
Don't replace explicit semantic tag overrides with lower-specificity preset styling.
Don't add noisy imagery, neon body text or promotional display typography to this operating workspace.
Don't ship synthetic acceptance records in product routes or present frontend fixture checks as a real testing cycle.
